title: Validation of isothermal amplification for determining the concentration of cell-free DNA (cfDNA)
summary: The EPI-CARE development consortium is working on a method that can quickly measure cfDNA in blood. They are comparing two methods: the standard method (qPCR in plasma) and isothermal amplification. They are also trying to concentrate circulating DNA. They use magnetic cfDNA beads to concentrate the DNA. These can be used manually or with a machine (a magnetic pipetting machine) made by Fraunhofer IMM. The different methods are compared to see how well they can concentrate and quantify the DNA.
conditions: Both healthy volunteers and patients with various acute and intensive care medical illnesses are included.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Liver transplant
- Patients with intracranial hemorrhage
- Infection
- Sepsis 
- Septic shock
- Patients after cardiogenic cardiac arrest and 
successful cardiopulmonary resuscitation)
- Patients with extracorporeal heart replacement (heart-lung machine, 
veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation) 
- Tumor disease 
- Rheumatological disease 
- Polytrauma
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnant women
- Breastfeeding women
- Palliative therapy approach or therapy goal limitation
